'''Shanan''' is a ''[[sul'dam]]'' from [[Seanchan]].{{ref/book|14|e}}

==Appearance==
She is smug-looking.

==Activities==
She places an ''[[a'dam]]'' on [[Moghedien]] after the [[Last Battle]] and takes her back to [[Ebou Dar]]. She explains that Moghedien is fair game to be captured as the Seanchan only have a treaty with Aes Sedai and Moghedien does not wear one of their rings and looks like she is up to no good.

== Trivia ==
* Shanan is named for Shannan Lieb, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda.[http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
* She is the last named character to be introduced in the Wheel of Time .
